title: The square alone
description: The 42 mm square with PE-DESIGN's default Fill and Zigzag line: the baseline the stamp captures are compared with.

references.make: PE-DESIGN 11.50, 180 x 130 mm page, App menu > New. Home > Shapes > rectangle dragged to a 42 x 42 mm square with PE's defaults (line Zigzag Stitch 2.0 mm, 4.5 line/mm, Half Stitch on; region Fill Stitch 4.5 line/mm, 45 degrees, under sewing on). Save with Save As as PES (PE-DESIGN 11's default PES version) under the file name given, and record it in compat/reference/MANIFEST.json.

measurements.evidence: 3,432 stitches at #471 (PE-DESIGN 3,251: its fill stops 1 mm inside the 2 mm zigzag line, 40 x 40 mm, OpenStitch's reaches the outline)
